decisions: The supplied implementation guides are references for explaining SCALE functionality. They do not establish core defaults or the current warehouse implementation.
Maintain one consolidated client-neutral SCALE functionality SDD, with Markdown and PDF as equivalent formats.
Exclude all material from the other product from the central SDD and its active help-source bindings.
Use neutral source codes in the reference and active help. Preserve original source files and historical evidence unchanged.
Retain local qualifications for version, configuration, source conflicts and proposed extensions; removing a client name does not turn a design choice into standard functionality.
Continue the next local help task after correcting the reference. Normal private Git delivery remains authorized.
